_doc: Pronunciation rules from audio-plan §3.5. Used two ways: (1) as an ElevenLabs alias dictionary (POST /v1/pronunciation-dictionaries/add-from-rules) when the key is allowed to create one, attached with pronunciation_dictionary_locators; (2) always baked into the `tts` text by parse-script.mjs (`ttsAlias`), so the fix survives a 401 on the dictionary endpoint and also reaches Kokoro. Whole-word, case-sensitive matches.
